derivation: from an unused root meaning probably to collect;
def: a reservoir; by analogy, a marsh

occurrences.text: And their nobles have sent their little ones to the waters: they came to the pits, and found no water; they returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and confounded, and covered their heads.
But the miry places thereof and the marishes thereof shall not be healed; they shall be given to salt.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
